author: Sai
name: Kingshot
short: MightPulse Kingshot statistics, alliance history and KvK dashboards
description: Kingshot player and alliance statistics, hourly roster snapshots, preparation score dashboards and kingdom event reminders using MightPulse. Mighty is required for events and KvK.
install_msg: Load kingshot, then use [p]ksset apikey to configure Red's shared MightPulse token securely. See [p]help ks and the kingshot README.
end_user_data_statement: Stores guild settings, dashboard IDs, public game roster/power snapshots, manual events and reminder markers. API keys use Red's bot-wide shared token storage.
